full_prompt_en: A square Art Deco decorative image places a slender white long-necked bird in the center of a tall fan-shaped red panel. The bird stands on a pale stepped plinth, facing left, with a pointed ochre beak, a graceful S-curved neck, and long layered wing feathers descending toward the lower right. Behind it, narrow gold rays spread upward through the dark red field, meeting a pointed arch at the top. Symmetrical cream and gold columns enclose the central panel on both sides; each column carries stacked geometric relief, small fan motifs, and sharply cut vertical grooves. The surrounding background is nearly black with faint decorative texture, so the pale plumage and warm metallic trim hold the strongest contrast. At the bottom, rectangular stone-like blocks and thin horizontal rules form a firm base beneath the delicate figure. The surfaces look like polished illustration or a refined enamel panel: color lies in crisp bounded shapes, while fine feather marks provide softer internal detail. Light is frontal and even, with small warm highlights on the gold ornament and restrained shadows under the feather layers. The composition has little atmospheric depth; instead, overlapping borders, raised-looking trim, and value contrast establish its layers. The overall design is formal and theatrical, joining a poised central silhouette with repeated arches, fan lines, and an elegant red, ivory, gold, and black palette.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形装饰艺术图像将一只修长的白色长颈鸟置于高而扇形的红色饰板中央。鸟站在浅色阶梯台座上，面朝左侧，带有赭黄色尖嘴、优雅的S形长颈，以及向右下垂落的层叠长羽。其后细金线在深红底面上向上放射，汇入顶部的尖拱。对称的奶油色与金色立柱从两侧围住中央饰板；每侧均有层叠几何浮饰、小扇形纹样和利落的竖向凹槽。周围背景近黑，带细微装饰肌理，因此浅色羽毛与暖金边饰形成最强对比。底部的矩形石质块面和纤细横线在柔美形体下构成稳固基座。表面像抛光的插画或精致珐琅饰板：色彩落在边界清晰的形内，细羽毛线提供较柔和的内部细节。光线正面而均匀，金饰上有小片暖亮，羽毛层下只有克制阴影。构图几乎没有空气纵深，而由重叠边框、仿佛凸起的饰边和明度反差建立层次。整体设计正式而富有舞台感，以安稳的中央剪影连接重复的拱线、扇线和红、象牙白、金、黑的优雅配色。
style_prompt_en: Decorative graphic treatment organizes crisp bounded color planes within symmetrical, nested geometry. Long vertical grooves, fine radiating lines, stepped bases, and repeated pointed curves build a deliberate rhythm, while small internal strokes soften selected areas. Deep oxblood red and near black provide depth for ivory and muted metallic gold to glow. Illumination is frontal and controlled, expressed by restrained highlights along raised-looking borders rather than natural cast shadows. Surfaces feel smooth and enamel-like, with fine printed texture in the darkest field. A tall central emphasis is steadied by balanced side masses and a firm horizontal base, creating ceremonial elegance.
style_prompt_zh: 装饰性图形处理将边界利落的色面组织进对称而嵌套的几何形。长竖槽、细放射线、阶梯基部与重复尖弧建立刻意的韵律，少量内部细线则柔化局部。深血红与近黑色为象牙白和暗金色的发亮提供纵深。照明正面而受控，借仿佛凸起的边框上克制的高光表现，而非自然投影。表面光滑且近似珐琅，最暗底面保有细微印刷纹理。高而突出的中央重点由均衡侧面体量与稳定水平基底托住，形成仪式般的优雅。
theme_en: A white long-necked bird inside a gilded fan-shaped ornament
theme_zh: 金饰扇形框中的白色长颈鸟
name: Art Deco
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
